fullContentHtml:
Patna High Court Assistant Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

High Court of Judicial at Patna (Bihar) has released the answer key for the post of Ex-Cadre Assistant (Group-C). This recruitment was released for 68 posts. Applications for the Patna High Court Assistant Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 28 July 2026, to 27 August 2026. The written examination was held on 18 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their Patna High Court Assistant Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 July 2026
  • Last Date : 27 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 18 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 12 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 24 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, EBC, BC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 750/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.

Patna High Court Assistant Answer Key 2026 contains the official answers. Candidates can verify their responses and submit objections if required.
